name: B10-0118/2025 (ECR) – Further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to put pressure on Georgia's government, which it accuses of turning away from democracy and toward Russia. It asks for new elections, the release of people it calls political prisoners, and sanctions on Georgia's leaders. It also wants the European Union to keep supporting Georgia's people and civil society groups, and to make future EU membership talks depend on democratic reforms.

- The European Union is asked to sanction Georgia's leaders and cut high-level contacts.
- Georgia's government and its people are affected.
- The European Union must decide whether to act on these requests.
